complete_examples.text: Finally, the soil is modeled by the 8-node solid elements, and the infinite element method (Francisco and Robert 1983) is adopted to simulate the boundary constraint.

The infinite element method is applied in the simulation of boundary constraints of the subgrade [34,35], which has an advantage over the spring-dashpot element, particularly in dealing with the far-field boundary.
